```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The socialist revolution will not base its legitimacy on the laws of the slaveholder constitution.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The socialist revolution will base its legitimacy on a democratic majority mandate for socialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A democratic majority mandate for socialism may be expressed by the popular vote of an election, but does not have to take that form if the state represses the ability to contest elections.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the right of the working class to take power by any means necessary.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To win a socialist republic, millions of working people must be mobilized in their workplaces, at the ballot box, and in the street.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The capitalist class relies on the minoritarian rule of the U.S. Constitution and will not give it up peacefully.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The working class will need armed self-defense to protect itself from the inevitable violence of reaction.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the democratic rights of enlisted U.S. soldiers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"To complete a successful revolution, a decisive section of the military rank and file must be won over to the side of the socialist movement.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for winning a plurinational democratic socialist republic in North America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Demand a New Republic and finish Reconstruction.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
